climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A state with 11 wineries and three AVAs: Shenandoah Valley, Ohio River Valley and Kanawha River Valley. Mountain winds dry the vine canopy and reduce fungal disease. Cold winters push most producers toward French hybrid and native Vitis labrusca grapes.
